title: Validate bidi independently of optional native geometry
disposition: Schema 2 independently asserts bidi and requires native geometry; missing-geometry and failed-bidi negative checks exit 2.

title: Validate native rectangles against independently derived rendered geometry
disposition: Expected native screen rectangles use independently measured framebuffer/view dimensions and rendered physical cells.

title: Clamp horizontal scrolling after text shrinks
disposition: Scroll offsets clamp to the remaining full layout extent after text shrinks.

title: Refresh edited layout before pointer hit-testing
disposition: Pointer placement refreshes queued-edit layout before hit testing.

title: Advance unsupported vertical runs along the rendered axis
disposition: Run offsets advance along the renderer axis; mixed-axis regression passes.

title: Make wrapped arrow transitions respect RTL paragraph direction
disposition: Wrapped horizontal arrows follow RTL paragraph direction and reverse to the same stop.

title: Choose the clicked line before comparing individual carets
disposition: Pointer line selection uses aggregate line bounds, including varied font heights.

title: Reject missing native geometry for visible cells
disposition: Missing geometry for any visible probe cell fails the native fixture.

title: Avoid repeatedly reshaping unchanged masked text
disposition: Masked layout freshness compares logical text and mask state; unchanged interaction reuses layout.

title: Preserve region fills for unsupported interaction runs
disposition: Vertical/math region fills keep their prior glyph-region fallback.

title: Prevent horizontal distance from overriding pointer line
disposition: Pointer lookup chooses a physical line before horizontal caret proximity.

title: Keep actualRange consistent with the clipped rectangle
disposition: Clipped native fragments now omit wholly hidden cells from actualRange; clipping probes pass.

title: Refresh edited text layout before vertical cursor movement
disposition: Vertical movement refreshes layout before reading caret geometry; queued-edit regression passes.

title: Avoid scanning the full paragraph separately for every run
disposition: Paragraph grapheme boundaries are computed once and passed into each run.

title: Visual navigation bypasses unsupported text
disposition: Mixed unsupported lines and unsupported cross-line transitions use logical-grapheme arrow fallback.

title: Unsupported runs are excluded from the scroll extent
disposition: Scroll extent includes rendered bounds and accumulated advances of unsupported runs.

title: Clamp stale scrolling before hit-testing refreshed text
disposition: Refresh normalizes stale scroll before pointer placement.

title: Avoid rebuilding paragraph interaction geometry on every draw
disposition: Render items reuse immutable interaction geometry; raster replay does not reconstruct it.

title: Incorrect hunk counts make the patch unapplyable
disposition: False positive from the patch nested inside a Git diff. Generated headers are valid. Every final hunk count (35) is mechanically checked; dry-run application and research/canonical prepare both pass. No manual header changes were made.

title: Vertical navigation ignores unsupported-line flags
disposition: Vertical movement rejects unsupported current/target lines and uses legacy fallback; mixed target regression passes.

title: Fall back when the clicked line has no interaction carets
disposition: Nearest reports unavailable when the chosen line has no supported carets.

title: Preserve legacy interaction for unsupported runs
disposition: Unsupported positioning, pointer and vertical navigation retain legacy fallback.

title: Coalesce selection cells before rasterizing
disposition: Selection ranges normalize for indexed lookup; adjacent physical cells coalesce and fully clipped fragments skip raster fill.

title: Merge cluster geometry before expanding to grapheme boundaries
disposition: Already handled by InteractionLayout: duplicate grapheme ranges merge across clusters and runs before caret creation. New split-cluster and split-run regression verifies one full-advance cell and only outer carets. No raw run cells are published directly.
